newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady in narrow trade.

text.p: Indian base metals held steady in a narrow price range on Monday despite low industrial demand, dealers said.
They said arrivals of imported metals were low as Indian importers booked few quantities during the yearend period as well as Christmas holidays.
"Arrivals will now pick up after a week," one dealer said.

Ready copper was steady at 12,400 rupees per quintal. It was up by 50 rupees during last week. Nickel was steady at the lower level of 36,200 rupees per quintal on restricted inflows on low demand. Nickel was down by 300 rupees last week.

Aluminium was unchanged at 7,200 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,450 rupees and lead at 4,400 rupees amid limited activity. Tin was available at last levels of 34,300 rupees per quintal but volume were low.
